reviewer: Codex: first-use kit, source and native invoice-output review
review_scope: Prepared fictional lesson plus actual native preparation and export regression outputs. The test uses an explicitly synthetic approval event to exercise the exporter; it is not a professional or learner approval and is never included in the kit. This review does not establish a human voice/two-window session or tax correctness.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The lesson teaches supplying invoice data, obtaining and reviewing a preview, approving or pausing export, finding the file and repeating the workflow. Its title names the function plainly; no missing-field puzzle displaces the ordinary use.
editorial.inputs_and_request: A short complete fictional text sheet is a natively supported input. The request states new draft, asks for the actual preview and reserves the exact export decision. Number, date, identifiers, VAT and routing are explicit exercise facts; no approval or prepared XML is supplied.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The working chat uses source evidence preparation, model interpretation, immutable draft preparation and the current exporter. Voice explains the observed progress. The checkpoints ask for purpose/source before starting and service/total/export decision in the actual preview.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The actual preview displays one invoice, its parties, line, quantity, price, VAT and total. The expandable table retains every field and source section. Native export checks produce schema-valid XML and a scoped export report only after a content-bound review event. The lesson teaches where to find these and that no issue, signature or transmission occurs.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice supplies a complete second invoice, with its own number/date and two units. It asks for a separate preview and export decision while preserving the first. The repeat instructions also mention readable PDFs/photos without pretending this text-source exercise verified native vision.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Italian guide and fixture interpretation match the source data. The preview uses Italian headings and some stable English decision keys. The six sections total 390 seconds, allowing processing and questions to extend the session. The timing is a teaching target, not an observed human duration.

demo.result_review: The actual native preview and XML contain DID-001, TD01, and total EUR 122.00, matching the selected source sheet. Native schema and arithmetic checks pass. The unapproved review request is rejected by the exporter; the subsequent test-only synthetic review event permits local export with SdI acceptance not tested. Original source and preview bytes remain unchanged, and the local run closes its artifact declaration. No real professional approval is asserted.
